extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users (grantee institution staff: FSR, signing officials, PIs, grants administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and data-entry guidance for preparing, searching, submitting, and certifying Federal Financial Reports (FFR) and Payment Requests in the eRA Commons (including PMS integration), plus module-level requirements (FCOI, IAR, Institution Profile).

rubrics_metrics.name: FFR access role requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If you hold the FSR Commons role, you have access to FFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have the FSR role in eRA Commons to access the FFR module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search specificity guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: IMPORTANT: When searching based on search criteria, enter as many criteria as possible to perform a narrower and specific search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Too broad of a search can result in a very large set of records returned by the FFR module, which might slow down the FFR response time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields and usage rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Available dropdowns/fields include Activity, IC (required; defaults to All), Serial, Year, Due Date Start / Due Date End, Project Number (enter at least four characters), Awarding Office/IC (select with checkboxes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Due Date Start/End: If only start entered, returns records on that date and after; if only end entered, returns records on that date and before. See Deciphering the NIH Application/Grant Numbers document for grant-number parts and IC abbreviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status-based search narrowing
rubrics_metrics.description: You may search for any combination of the following statuses: Pending, Due, Late, Received, In Review, Accepted, Rejected, Revision Pending.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To select more than one status, select the first, then click the dropdown again to select another; each selected status appears with an 'x' that can be clicked to remove it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick search definitions and use
rubrics_metrics.description: Quick searches are one-click, pre-defined searches providing a convenient method of retrieving commonly entered criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Received' returns FFRs in status Received for all ICs; 'Pending, Due, or Late' returns those statuses for all ICs; 'Due this year' returns Received records with start/end date spanning current year. If quick searches not visible, click Reset Search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpreting search results columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Search results include: Award/Project Number (linked to Grant Folder), Doc No, three-dot ellipsis menu (actions), FFR Type (semi-annual, annual, final), Spec. Funding, FFR Due, Submitted to Agency, Budget Start, Budget End, Latest FFR Status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use column headers to sort, navigation tools to page through results, and Export button to open results in Excel (separate window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Action availability varies by FFR status
rubrics_metrics.description: All available actions are accessible via the three-dot ellipsis menu next to the Award/Project Number; available actions vary depending on FFR status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the 'FFR Actions' mapping to know which actions (Manage FFR, History, PDF) are available for statuses like Pending, Due, Late, Received, In Review, Accepted, Rejected, Revision Pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage FFR action behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage FFR redirects to PMS, where (after you login) it opens the FFR long form for editing and submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can initiate a new FFR or return to a partially completed FFR to continue editing. Note: you must register with PMS and obtain credentials and be logged into PMS before or during FFR initiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: View PDF action availability
rubrics_metrics.description: View PDF opens the current version of the report in PDF format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option is available for FFRs in statuses Received, In Review, Accepted, Rejected, and Revision Pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: History action contents
rubrics_metrics.description: History displays a history of actions performed against the FFR record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: History includes date received by agency (if applicable), user that created the FFR, agency staff who processed the FFR (or N/A), status of FFR, and View Actions. Click the caret next to Award/Project Number to display history beneath the record.

rubrics_metrics.name: No-Cost Extension (NCE) display
rubrics_metrics.description: A green NCE icon next to the award number indicates a no-cost extension (NCE) has been applied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click the down arrow next to Award Number to see both regular FFR (REG) details and NCE details (E1, E2, etc); use additional arrows to toggle more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: PMS registration requirement for FFR initiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Before attempting to complete and submit an FFR, you must register with PMS and obtain login credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You are required to log into PMS before or during FFR initiation from eRA Commons. For HHS awards, the FFR long form opens in PMS; for DOC and NIFA awards, users fill out the FFR long form in the eRA Commons FFR module instead of being redirected to PMS.

rubrics_metrics.name: FFR initiation steps
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps: search for FFR in eRA Commons, select Manage FFR, log into PMS when redirected, complete the PMS FFR long form fields, and follow PMS guidance for certifying and submitting the FFR to the sponsoring agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, find FFR directly in PMS by searching for the Award Document Number using the PMS FFR search screen. See PMS user guide for certification/submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line 1–6 prepopulated/non-editable fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Several top-line fields are pre-populated from award information and cannot be edited: Line 1 (Federal Agency), Line 2 (Federal Grant / Subaccount Award Document Number), Line 3 (Recipient Organization name/address), Line 4a UEI Number, Line 4b EIN, Line 6 Report Type (Quarterly/Semi-Annual/Annual/Final).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These values come from the award and are not user-editable in the FFR long form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis of Accounting selection (Line 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Cash or Accrual to indicate the basis used for recording award-related transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accrual: expenses recorded when incurred. Cash: expenses recorded when paid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project/Grant Period and Reporting Period End Date behavior (Lines 8–9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Line 8 (Project/Grant Period From/To) and Line 9 (Reporting Period End Date) are pre-populated from award information and cannot be edited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting Period End Date determines the end date through which cumulative transactions (Line 10) must be reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transactions cumulative reporting rule (Line 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each field in the Transactions section, enter the cumulative amounts from the date of inception of the award through the end date of the specified reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All amounts are cumulative up to the Reporting Period End Date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Cash rules and final-report constraints (Lines 10a–10c)
rubrics_metrics.description: 10.a Cash Receipts: cumulative actual cash received; 10.b Cash Disbursements: cumulative Federal fund disbursements; 10.c Cash on Hand: system-calculated (10a minus 10b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For HHS recipients these fields are prepopulated in PMS but may be recalculated. For Annual FFRs recipients can update; for Final FFRs, 10a and 10b must be equal and 10c must be $0.00. 10c is calculated and cannot be edited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal expenditures and unobligated balance rules (Lines 10d–10h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use lines 10.d–10.h for single grant reporting: 10.d Total Federal funds authorized; 10.e Federal share of expenditures; 10.f Federal share of unliquidated obligations; 10.g Total Federal share (calculated); 10.h Unobligated balance (calculated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 10.e: Enter federal fund expenditures (sum of disbursements, indirect charges, payments to subrecipients/contractors). A Final FFR cannot be submitted unless 10e equals 10a and 10b. 10.f: Enter unliquidated obligations; on final report this line must be zero; do not include amounts already reported in 10e or future commitments for which obligations/expenses haven't been incurred. 10.g and 10.h are system-calculated and not editable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient share reporting rules (Lines 10i–10k)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not complete recipient share section if reporting on multiple awards. 10.i Total recipient share required; 10.j Recipient share of expenditures; 10.k Remaining recipient share to be provided (calculated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 10.i should include required matching/cost sharing but not amounts in excess of what agency requires. 10.j includes actual cash disbursements/outlays, payments to subrecipients, allowable in-kind match, and recipient share of program income used as non-Federal share. On final report, 10.j should be equal to or greater than 10.i. 10.k is calculated and will show zero if 10.j > 10.i.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program income reporting rules (Lines 10l–10o)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not complete program income section if reporting for multiple awards. 10.l Total Federal program income earned; 10.m Program income expended (deduction alternative); 10.n Program income expended (addition alternative); 10.o Unexpended program income (calculated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 10.l should exclude program income used as recipient cost sharing reported in 10.j. 10.o = 10.l minus amounts reported under the chosen alternative (10m or 10n). 10.o is calculated and cannot be edited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect expenses limitations and fields (Line 11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect expenses: in PMS you are limited to 10 indirect expenses; if more than 10, enter the rest in the Remarks field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields per entry include Type (Provisional, Predetermined, Final, Fixed), Rate (percentage), Period From/To, Base, Amount Charged, Federal Share. Totals fields are calculated sums for Base, Amount Charged, and Federal Share.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remarks field usage (Line 12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter any explanations or additional information required by the Federal sponsoring agency including excess cash as stated in Cash on Hand (10c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remarks are required when submitting a revision to an FFR or on an Annual FFR if Cash on Hand (10c) is greater than $0.00. Also use Remarks to list indirect expenses beyond the first 10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepared by and contact info behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Select your username from the Prepared by dropdown to complete preparation of the FFR; phone and email are prepopulated based on PMS credentials and not editable; Date Report Prepared auto-populates today's date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Non-HHS recipients this information is pre-populated from the logged-in user's account and cannot be edited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit/Certify workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: After selecting Prepared by, click Submit. The FFR must be Certified; the certifier receives a notification from PMS when an FFR is ready to be certified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are the certifier, log into PMS, locate the FFR, select your username from Signature of Authorized Certifying Official dropdown, then Certify. If Certify button not visible, submit the form first. You can Save to come back later; saved forms appear as Work in Progress. Use eRA Commons FFR module to check submission status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Request role privileges (DOC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Role Name: FSR (Grantee). Users with this role can access Payment Request functionality in FFR, initiate/save/submit Payment Requests for awards to their organization, track Payment Request status, and view Payment Request history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proper roles are required for grantee users to complete payment-request tasks; DOC awardees should consult Payment Request for DOC Awardees in eRA Commons Online Help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Request search criteria and status options
rubrics_metrics.description: Searchable by Project/Application Number (≥4 characters), Awarding Office/IC, Last Payment Request Status (All, Work In Progress, Submitted, Approved, Declined, Authorized in ASAP, Payment Processed, Payment Failed, Payment on Hold), Period Covered by Request Start/End.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To conduct a general search click Search without criteria. Use Clear Search Form to reset. Start date returns records with start date of entered date or later; end date returns records with end date of entered date or earlier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Request result fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Search results display Application Number, Period Covered by Request Start/End, Amount requested, Requested Drawdown Date, PD/PI, GMS/GMO Name, Last Payment Request Status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For projects with no previous payment request, only Application Number / (PD/PI) / (GMS/GMO Name) will be displayed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constraints for initiating new DOC Payment Request
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees can only submit a new request on the same project if the last payment request is not submitted or is in Declined / Authorized in ASAP / Payment Processed / Payment Failed status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If last request is in other statuses, you cannot create a new request for that project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creating a Payment Request: required fields and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: To create: choose Create New Payment Request action. Required fields include Request Draw Down Date, Requested Amount, Period Covered From/To, Total Expenditures to Date, Total Federal Funds Previously Requested. Justification up to 200 characters and attachments (SF-270/271 and others) are optional/available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attachments must be PDF files ≤6MB. You can upload up to 10 files per upload field. Use Save to save a request (goes to Work In Progress). Edit saved requests via Edit Payment Request action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Request history contents
rubrics_metrics.description: History shows Event Number (sequential per project), Requested Amount, Requested Draw Down Date, Period Covered by Request, Justification text, Status, and agency staff comments (if any).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access history via three-dot ellipsis and View Payment Request History to track prior requests and agency feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCOI module mandatory reporting and roles
rubrics_metrics.description: The FCOI module is mandatory for all institutions; the organization's Signing Official (SO) completes reporting unless delegated (SO can assign FCOI_ASST and FCOI_View roles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FCOI module capabilities: initiate/prepare FCOI reports, electronically submit reports and supporting documents and annual FCOI reports, receive notifications upon submission/receipt, search/view previously submitted FCOI reports, revise initial 2011 FCOI Report for retrospective review or Mitigation Report, access history of actions, assign FCOI access to other Commons users. Reporting requirements reference 42 CFR Part 50 Subpart F.

rubrics_metrics.name: IAR module purpose and reviewer capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet Assisted Review (IAR) supports scientific peer review by letting Reviewers submit critiques, preliminary scores, final scores, and view grant applications and meeting materials via Commons; reviewers may view others' critiques before the meeting unless conflicts exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IAR must be used in tandem with the Peer Review module; users must hold the IAR role and be enabled for review meetings. IAR has its own online help system for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Profile (IPF) registration and SO privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must be registered in Commons; the Institution Profile is a central repository for organization information and must be maintained by the institution. The IPF is populated at registration and assigned a unique IPF number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPF main tabs: Institution Basic Information, Institutional Assurances and Certifications, Policy Documents (SO only). Only SOs can edit Institution Profile screens and see the Policy Documents tab (which contains institutional FCOI policy). Access to IPF is limited by Commons role (AA, AO, ASST, BO, FSR, PI, POSTDOC, SCIENTIST, SPONSOR, or SO).
